spine: Kulke & Rothermund, A History of India (grade A, in collection)
rules: One lesson = one block: reading slice with a guide, story + timeline + map, one primary source, a 'why did this happen?' question.
Every unit (~5 lessons) ends with a unit check, a ~300-word historian's answer, and a debate paired with a present-day public claim.
